_comment: They live in JSON, not in the .test.ts file, because every `line` below is
deliberately written in the vocabulary the gate exists to reject. The gate
scans .tsx/.jsx/.ts/.md/.mdx, so putting these strings in the harness would
make the test fail the very check it asserts over — and blocking the repo to
test the blocker is not a trade worth making. A data file is also the right
home for adversarial fixtures: the table grows without touching the harness.
`caught`  — copy the gate MUST report. `term` is matched case-insensitively.
`skipped` — identifier/exempt shapes the gate must stay silent about; the
harness asserts the report is completely empty for each.

caught.name: first word of a single-quoted string — real escape, commit 39cc7a76
caught.line: label: 'Faculty & tutor hires awaiting your signature',

caught.name: last word of a template literal — real escape, commit 39cc7a76
leading word of a double-quoted string
trailing word against a closing backtick

skipped.name: quoted identifier in an array literal
assessment-domain words against a closing quote
skipped.line: const t = 'Enter marks for the grade';

skipped.name: assessment-domain words after an opening quote
skipped.line: const t = 'grades and grading are exempt';
